answer_1.quote: We trained a large language model (LLM) to perform two tasks: Next Utterance Prediction and Game State Tracking.
answer_1.outputs: next utterances in a Dungeons & Dragons game, conditioned on conversational history and game state variables

answer_2.quote: Figure  plots the Negative log perplexity on our development set, and Table  shows the final perpexity and token accuracies on the dev set.

answer_4.quote: We recruited professional raters to perform a manual evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators asked to rate each output along the three dimensions: • Does the response make sense? (yes/no) • Is the response specific? (yes/no) • How interesting is the response? (10 point scale)
